rationale: The discourse has stabilized into a well-defined but unresolved impasse: labor and the state still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management, the family, and investors still insist those tools remain available unless the quantified gap is closed. The last two rounds produced more repetition than movement, and the missing variable remains the same site-by-site savings bridge, so a procedural intervention or tighter fact-finding would be more useful than another generic round.
